objective: Reduce the critical visible-primitive-placeholder risk in benchmark framing by replacing retained structural Unity Cube/Cylinder renderer meshes with dimension-baked physical edge geometry while preserving world footprint and gameplay collision.

commits.summary: Added deterministic dimension-baked chamfered structural surface mesh library.
Added retained structural surface refinement with renderer/collider footprint preservation and raw-primitive QA.
Added machine-readable manufacture/construction and geometry responsibility contract.
Added quality-scene save gate so high-detail saves enforce structural primitive replacement.
Bound structural-surface contract and persisted-scene validation into the complete native-4K review packet.

targetedAssemblies: legacy park/street furniture only when still actively rendered

staticReview: Dimensions are baked from the existing local primitive scale and transform scale is normalized only after collider dimensions are adjusted.
Renderer and collider world bounds are compared before/after conversion with a 2 mm maximum deviation.
Square rail sections use a 2 mm bevel cap so the cleanup does not turn manufactured square stock into rounded tubing.
Large concrete masses use a restrained 6 mm arris break rather than a stylized roundover.
No visual score or critical-defect clearance is inferred from source structure.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometry_construction: HIGH_EXPECTED_RISK_REDUCTION: removes razor-edge/raw-primitive shading from more than 300 benchmark-facing structural target slots when the Unity pass executes.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.lighting_shadows_reflections: MEDIUM_EXPECTED: physical millimetric edge strips can produce real grazing highlights instead of impossible infinitely sharp edges.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporal_lod_aliasing: LOW_TO_MEDIUM_EXPECTED: normalized dimension-baked geometry avoids scale-dependent edge response, but native temporal probes are still required.

nextBlocker: A Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner is still required to compile the new scripts, execute the save gate, confirm generated mesh/collider bounds in-engine, and produce sealed 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing evidence plus temporal probes.
nextActionWhenRunnerAppears: Run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet.
Fix any compile/save-gate/footprint-preservation failure before scoring.
Inspect hero/oblique/grazing 100% crops for residual primitive silhouettes, oversized bevel highlights, concrete edge plasticity, rail edge response and legacy LampGlobe regression.
Score only the sealed rendered evidence and fix the largest actual deductions first.
